'''Greg Allen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Who Got Game? tournament]] in October 1999 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base / Kessel Run]], according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d85">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-25-tr-who-got-gamed85/ tr-who-got-game], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 25 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-25-tr-who-got-gamed85/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
